arithmetic: Exact Q and exact algebraic radical Kraus amplitudes in SymPy; no numerical tolerance in assertions.
conventions: Row-major coefficient vectorization for explicit Eij C orbit columns; positive H block inverse, not zI-H at z zero; exact Kraus squared weights and the single code density P.

model_results.seed_support: Explicit Eij C orbit spans have dimensions 2 and 4; C2 and C3 jointly span all 6 coordinates. Their stacked coefficient rows have rank 3 and the finite capacity ceiling is 2 seeds.
model_results.block_inverse: For positive H=[[2,1],[1,3]], Schur complement of H is 5/3, full inverse retained entry is 3/5, compressed-H inverse is 1/2, discrepancy is 1/10. This checks H block inversion and does not reinterpret signs as the zI-H Feshbach map at z=0.
model_results.channel_scale: Exact Kraus matrices with squared weights 3/4 and 1/4 form a trace-preserving channel. Weights 3 and 1 give completeness scalar 4 and trace 4 on the single declared code state P. No general recovery assertion.

non_claims: Three fixed pedagogical models only; no universal theorem proof or continuum claim.
